text: The atmosphere here is a strange intersection of anticipation and curiosity. The transparent meeting room, sterile and waiting, suggests a place for minds to gather and ideas to form; yet it’s eerily empty, and I feel a hint of loneliness in the unoccupied chairs. Passing through into the exhibit, surrounded by bold colors and immersive digital displays about research and development, I sense an undercurrent of innovation—my mind feels stimulated by the visual energy of the space, as though I’ve stepped into a living workshop of human creativity. In this setting, I feel the optimism of progress and the reflective solitude of silent preparation, suspended between the world of thought and action.
